messages:
olivia: Hey support — since this morning our web chat widgets are seeing much slower initial bytes for streaming responses. TTFB p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~1.6s; non-streaming total time looks fine. Any quick thoughts?

kevin: hey @olivia — sorry about that. can you paste a request-id and whether you're using SSE or h2? any repro steps?

olivia: repro: curl --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Request-ID: r-123-stream-01" -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b","stream":true, "prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate

kevin: thanks. will pull logs for r-123-stream-01.

dana: looking at proxy traces for r-123-stream-01 — I see several CHUNK_FLUSH wait events between runtime -> proxy. first chunk arrived at runtime quickly, but proxy delayed flush until buffer/timer. cc @michelle

michelle: noted. did infra push any proxy coalescing / flush-timer changes yesterday? @sam any deploys?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: infra/proxy v2.14.3 deployed 2026-03-14T09:15 by infra-deploy (change: coalesce-window default -> 20ms for streaming routes)

sam: hypothesis: coalesce-window bump means proxy will wait up to 20ms to coalesce small frames into fewer packets. that can increase TTFB for customers who send/expect very small first chunks. non-stream total unaffected because payloads finish later.

kevin: workaround options:
- customer-side: set stream_chunk_size=1 or send a leading "\"\n\"" token to force immediate chunking
- server-side: we can add header support to bypass coalescing: X-Redwood-Prefer-Flush: true
(we temporarily added that header in staging for testing)

dana: reproduced locally in staging with small script:
```
# repro.sh
curl --http2 -H "Authorization: Bearer <staging>" -H "X-Request-ID: stg-890" -d '{"model":"redwood-open-7b","stream":true}' https://staging.api.redwood.com/v1/generate
# observe first chunk delayed ~18-22ms with default proxy coalesce window
# with header X-Redwood-Prefer-Flush: true -> first chunk ~2-3ms
```

michelle: thanks. I'll push a targeted hotfix to reduce coalesce-window for streaming routes to 5ms and add header passthrough for customers who need immediate-first-byte semantics. will watch metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: infra/proxy v2.14.4 hotfix deployed 2026-03-14T10:03 (coalesce-window streaming -> 5ms; support header X-Redwood-Prefer-Flush passthrough)

olivia: quick check from our side after 10:10 PT — TTFB p95 back to ~140ms, p99 down to 220ms. big improvement, thanks :thumbsup:

sam: follow-up action items:
- INF-4521: add first-chunk-latency per-route metric + alert p95>500ms
- INF-4522: document X-Redwood-Prefer-Flush header and add to support runbook
- INF-4523: add e2e test for streaming first-byte under proxy coalescing changes

kevin: adding short playbook to support docs with header workaround and customer-facing guidance. closing on our side once docs up.

dana: leaving thread open for one more hour to monitor; will update ticket when metrics stable.

olivia: thanks everyone, happy to help verify.

kevin: thanks all — marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
